{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Compute response rate per site
response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean() * 100  # Convert to percent

# Sort in descending order to find the highest
response_rates_sorted = response_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the site with the highest response rate
highest_site = response_rates_sorted.index[0]
highest_rate = response_rates_sorted.iloc[0]

print("Response rates by site (percent):\n", response_rates_sorted)
print(f"\nHighest response rate: {highest_rate:.2f}% at site {highest_site}")"}
